signals.title: What one year of committing to making more of what you love can do: Inside the magical world of Tala Schlossberg
signals.description: Artist and animator Tala Schlossberg’s work sits at the intersection of sound, pictures and words and the way they interact with time. A year before she joined us on stage at September’s Nicer Tuesdays in New York, the artist set off on a new creative chapter leaving the city behind for the New Mexico desert. Committing to spending time on the things she loves, the artist gives us an insight into all the activities that challenged her to experiment, all eventually leading to the making of Play Music Theory: An app and visual instrument designed to explore the relationship between sound, shapes and time.
